name: Gujarat Forensic Sciences University
evidence: The official NFSU About page identifies National Forensic Sciences University as the erstwhile Gujarat Forensic Sciences University and states that it has the status of an Institution of National Importance.
notes: Normal TLS verification reported the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was used for public GET requests. The supplied legacy domain returned 502, so the successor's official page was used because it explicitly identifies the legacy institution.
